definition.def: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important.
examples: The port is vital to supply relief to millions of drought victims.
Nick Wileman is a school caretaker so it is vital that he gets on well with young people.
After her release, she was able to give vital information about her kidnapper.

definition.def: If you describe someone or something as vital, you mean that they are very energetic and full of life.
examples: They are both very vital people and a good match.
They have something important to say and vital and radical ways of saying it.
